questions.stem: At what Enchanting skill can you place the Arcane Forge camp object?
questions.explanation: The Enchanted Lute comes at skill 20, the Arcane Salvager at 140 and the Arcane Forge at 300.

questions.stem: Cooking upgrades raise a campsite's limit of camp features. What is the highest limit?
questions.explanation: A basic campsite holds 3 camp features, and Cooking upgrades raise that to 5 or 10.

questions.stem: What does Artisan Enchanting training need?
questions.explanation: Journeyman needs skill 50 and level 10, Expert skill 125 and level 20, and Artisan skill 200 and level 35.

questions.stem: What does the Legacy perk Dedicated Study give an enchanter once all their skills are 300?
questions.explanation: Dedicated Study gives a daily skill-up until all your skills are 300, and Elemental Essences after that.

questions.stem: Which of these is one of the new enchants for two-hand weapons?
questions.explanation: Mighty Spell Power, Mighty Healing Power and Spellblasting are the new two-hand enchants. Deflection is one of the new necklace enchants.

questions.stem: How much Merchant's Favor do the necklace enchant recipes cost?
questions.explanation: Necklace enchants need Enchanting 210, Friendly and 120 Favor. The two-hand caster enchants need 300, Honored and 240 Favor.
